synopsis: The dark-fantasy Metroidvania sequel to Ender Lilies — retained as the Limited Run Games Nintendo Switch physical edition.

curatorNotes:
Ender Magnolia: Bloom in the Mist is set decades after Ender Lilies: Lilac, an Attuner, purifies rampaging artificial beings called Homunculi across the Land of Fumes. The band Mili again provides the music.

After early access on PC, it released in full on January 22, 2025, including on Nintendo Switch. Limited Run Games produced the Western physical edition for Binary Haze, outside its numbered series, taking pre-orders in mid-2025.

This filing opens the Ender lineage on the shelf.
collectionNotes:
The retained object is Limited Run Games’ standard physical edition of Ender Magnolia: Bloom in the Mist for Nintendo Switch, produced for Binary Haze Interactive.

Dedicated artifact views of the individual copy have not yet been filed; the gallery below is held open for that documentation.

preservation.playableOn: Nintendo Switch; compatible Nintendo Switch family hardware
preservation.compatibility: Nintendo Switch software is region-free. The retained game card is the primary access copy and runs on any Nintendo Switch console.
preservation.concerns: Game cards are flash media; long-term charge retention, contact wear, and loss of the small card from its case are the principal risks. Any content delivered as an eShop download or update depends on Nintendo’s servers and is not preserved by the card alone.
preservation.knownRevisions: PC early access March 25, 2024; full release January 22, 2025 across platforms, with a Japanese physical edition on January 23. Limited Run Games’ Western physical edition (HAC-P-BG6CA) was taken on pre-order from June to July 2025.
preservation.availability: Limited Run Games’s physical edition was a limited production and now circulates through the secondary market. The digital Switch edition was issued separately on the Nintendo eShop.
